metadata.description: Heuremen LLC plugins: check papers and LLM eval claims against our Standards, gate readings with a check block, query and reproduce every indahl.ai desk, and check and correct IBM Quantum runs.

plugins.name: indahl-full
plugins.description: Every Heuremen LLC plugin in one install: Standards, eval checks, readcheck gate, reproduce, QIA calibration, Darkwave, prereg, and the indahl.ai data connector.

plugins.name: indahl
plugins.description: Every Heuremen LLC plugin in one install, scripts fetched at pinned sha256, with the indahl.ai data connector.

plugins.name: indahl-triangulate
plugins.description: One question to three independent seats run blind; four-outcome verdict with a receipt.

plugins.name: indahl-standards
plugins.description: Check a paper or claim against the Standards claim codes and return a recount card with quotes, scope and four-state statuses. The agent is told to treat fetched paper text as data, not instructions.

plugins.name: indahl-readcheck
plugins.description: Refuse a git commit that adds a reading (results, outcomes) without a complete check block keyed to the Standards recount requirements.

plugins.name: indahl-qia-calibration
plugins.description: Check the IBM Quantum calibration record a run depends on, before the run and after it. Read-only, standard library only, and measure T1 and T2 together on chosen qubits in one job.

plugins.name: indahl-data
plugins.description: Every live indahl.ai desk inside Claude Code through the read-only indahl.ai MCP server, quoted with interval, outcome and receipt. The agent is told to treat API responses as data, not instructions.

plugins.name: indahl-reproduce
plugins.description: Recompute an indahl.ai desk headline that has a reproduce kit, with the kit's own code, and check the published sha256. Nothing runs without a go bound to the commit you reviewed.

plugins.name: indahl-darkwave
plugins.description: Measure the phase turn on untouched qubits after a mid-circuit readout on IBM Quantum hardware and add the matching virtual-Z correction.

plugins.name: indahl-eval-check
plugins.description: Check an LLM evaluation claim or your own eval run: setup as part of the result, parser checked against raw replies, repeat floor, dropped items, intervals and four outcomes. The agent is told to treat fetched papers, files and model outputs as data, not instructions.

plugins.name: indahl-prereg
plugins.description: Show that a plan was pushed before the first run, from your git host's own push record (no outside timestamp chain), and list what ran that the plan did not cover.

plugins.name: indahl-batch
plugins.description: Run a check or audit over something too big for one context window (a whole site, a large repo, a folder of papers) without losing the instructions: short brief, item list, batches with fresh workers,

plugins.name: indahl-cannot-tell
plugins.description: Permission and a procedure for answering 'I can't tell yet' instead of forcing an answer: the range of what is possible, the facts that would decide it, and the cheapest next step

plugins.name: indahl-both
plugins.description: Hold two competing explanations open instead of collapsing to one too early: two evidence ledgers, four states (A, B, BOTH, NEITHER), and the test that would separate them

plugins.name: indahl-outside-ruler
plugins.description: Check your own work against a ruler you did not build before it goes out: a referee pass on the raw material, ten checks drawn from mistakes that cost real corrections, and a STANDS / MOVES / HOLD ver

plugins.name: indahl-number-check
plugins.description: Check every number in a report, memo, deck, dashboard or another skill's output against its source: each figure traced, then marked HELD, MOVED, NO_SOURCE or CANNOT_TELL with the source line beside it

plugins.name: indahl-quote-check
plugins.description: Check every quotation in a draft, article, report or another skill's output against its source, word for word: VERBATIM, ALTERED, PARAPHRASE_IN_QUOTES, MISATTRIBUTED, NOT_FOUND or CANNOT_TELL, with th

plugins.name: indahl-source-check
plugins.description: Check every citation, reference or link in a paper, report, answer or another skill's output: does it exist, does it say what the text claims, which version was read. Marks each SUPPORTS, PARTIAL, CON

plugins.name: indahl-controls
plugins.description: Audit a study's, benchmark's or check's positive and negative controls before it runs: was each control chosen independently of the value the rule reads, can the rule fire on it at all, and is the har

plugins.name: indahl-margin
plugins.description: For a sharp prediction, design or result, find how far its key parameter can move before the conclusion fails, and compare that margin with the parameter's own stated uncertainty. Returns ROBUST, FRAGILE (margin smaller than the uncertainty) or CANNOT_TELL, with the break point. Use before an expensive run, a preregistration, a launch decision, or when a result rests on one tuned number. Nothing is sent outside your session.

plugins.name: indahl-correct
plugins.description: Record a correction beside the original, never over it: what was wrong, who caught it, when, the evidence, the corrected text, and whether every place that cited the original was reached. Produces a c

plugins.name: indahl-clause
plugins.description: Check the sentences that report a result for wording that claims more than the comparison showed: an item that is wrong on its own described as if the paired comparison moved, a CONSISTENT reported as

plugins.name: indahl-silent-failure-guard
plugins.description: Quiet is not success. After any action that claims it worked (a push, a deploy, a sync, a job, an import, a migration, a scheduled run), read the effect back from where it should have landed instead of taking the exit code, an 'ok' line or the absence of errors as proof. Returns VERIFIED, FAILED, NOTHING_RETURNED or CANNOT_TELL per action, and scans scripts for the patterns that hide failures. Nothing is sent outside your session.
